verdicts.decision_note: The client defines the board orientation, top-edge connector placement, interboard connector alignment, and short cable-routing acceptance behavior.
The client adds an accessible physical-layout constraint that minimizes placement on the downward-facing bottom side.
The client permits smaller connectors on the top or sides to improve cable accessibility while retaining the top-edge rule for high-pin-count connectors.
The client specifies an implementation-relevant placement and orientation for the main board's lower connectors beneath the upper row where possible.
The client applies the accessible connector-layout approach to the sensor board by moving its bottom connectors upward and changing their orientation.
